calibration.qualification: The eight-record preflight overlaps the 50-record cohort. Balanced excerpts recover pydicom1256 outside that cohort; no overall accuracy claim. Presence coverage measures file/function headers, not full causal body retention.

decision: Freeze balanced excerpts for uniform v2 inputs: no loss in the 50 train development cases and avoids first-function character starvation. Remaining misses are retained, never reference-assisted or filtered.
missing_definition_policy: Record causal absence separately from function present in failing source; do not invent base lines or discard samples for missing definition/retrieval misses.
heldout_policy: No heldout causal input, labels or model predictions used for retrieval tuning before this freeze. Existing heldout reconstruction success states are environment gates only.
